title: A First Look at System One Decision Models for Malware Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.20699v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Malware detection needs scores calibrated at a fixed false positive rate (FPR) and decisions an analyst can read: feature-based detectors give the first, large language models (LLMs) on decompiled code the second, through generated text of uncalibrated confidence. System One decision models answer a typed question about a text with a probability over its declared answers in one forward pass. We present the first evaluation of these models for Windows Portable Executable malware detection, analyze how they decide, and propose S1Mal, an ensemble on the typed answers and the embedding of CLM-8B. In an isolated virtual machine, Ghidra and capa decompose each binary, and the host renders the records into a canonical textual state, a digest of headers, imports, MITRE ATT&CK capabilities and strings, optionally with decompiled functions, without class shortcuts. Three readouts score each model on the state: A0, the probability of one verdict

translated_title: 恶意软件检测中System One决策模型的首次探析
translated_abstract: 恶意软件检测需要在固定误报率（FPR）下经过校准的分数，以及分析人员能够直接读懂的决策：基于特征的检测器提供前者，而针对反编译代码的大型语言模型（LLM）通过生成置信度未经校准的文本来提供后者。System One决策模型通过单次前向传播，以对其声明答案的概率分布来回答关于文本的类型化问题。我们对这类模型在Windows便携式可执行（PE）恶意软件检测中的应用进行了首次评估，分析了它们的决策方式，并提出了S1Mal——一种基于类型化答案与CLM-8B嵌入的集成模型。在一个隔离的虚拟机中，Ghidra和capa对每个二进制文件进行解析，主机将记录渲染为规范的文本状态，即文件头、导入表、MITRE ATT&CK能力和字符串的摘要，可选地包含反编译函数，且不包含类别捷径。三种读出方式对每个模型在该状态上进行评分：A0，即单一判定结论的概率……
tldr: 本文首次评估了System One决策模型在Windows PE恶意软件检测中的表现，并提出结合类型化答案与CLM-8B嵌入的集成方法S1Mal，在不含类别捷径的规范化文本状态上实现可读且经过校准的恶意软件判定。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first evaluation of System One decision models for Windows PE malware detection and proposes S1Mal, an ensemble combining typed answers with CLM-8B embeddings, achieving readable and calibrated malware verdicts on canonical textual states without class shortcuts.
